body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.73 (naive sector base rate 0.75) that: Simpson FY2026 capital expenditures are within $80-90 mn. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/US_INDUSTRIALS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.75 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', all-category fallback, n=1); SAC -7.0 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.73. Evidence: Q2-2026 release and Q3-2026 call: capex $80-90 mn (Feb guide $75-85 mn). FY2025 $161.0 mn (Gallatin/Columbus build-out), outside its last range by 0.6%. Resolution: YES if FY2026 PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment in the FY2026 Form 10-K XBRL is >= $80.0 mn and <= $90.0 mn. Source: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (FY2026 10-K). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.75 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', all-category fallback, n=1); SAC -7.0 pts x weight 0.259 (N=7) -> p = 0.73
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'capacity' promises among the other US industrials peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=1, too few in category so all-category peer rate used). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY2026 PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment in the FY2026 Form 10-K XBRL is >= $80.0 mn and <= $90.0 mn.

title: Paper call: Simpson FY2026 capital expenditures are within $80-90 mn
